# AI Alchemy

> AI Alchemy is an architecture-first technology consulting and engineering company based in the Greater Toronto Area. We design, build and connect the software, AI automation and data your teams run on. One team, from strategy to go-live.

Systems Integration & Modernization is the lead offering. It includes CRM and ERP integrations and migrations: connecting the systems a business already runs, modernizing what holds it back, and building only what is missing. Built in-house. No outsourcing.

Our Products & Innovation division develops proprietary software and AI technologies. Our own products are taking shape. More to share soon.

Client work is also organized as four services: strategy and architecture, custom software and modernization, enterprise AI and automation, and cloud and data. We are based in the Greater Toronto Area.

Clients stay in control. We design systems around each client's processes, approval requirements and decision-making authority.

To start a project, send a short project brief. It takes three steps. Your brief opens as an email you send. We reply within one business day. Email: hello@ai-alchemy.ca

## Services

- [Services overview](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/): Systems Integration & Modernization leads, including CRM and ERP integrations and migrations, with the four services below.
- [Strategy & Architecture](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/strategy-architecture/): Make the right technology decisions before you commit to development. We assess your current systems, find the gaps and draw a practical roadmap tied to business priorities.
- [Custom Software & Modernization](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/custom-software-modernization/): Stop working around outdated software. We modernize legacy applications, replace manual processes and build software around how you operate.
- [Enterprise AI & Automation](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/enterprise-ai-automation/): Put AI where it can do useful work. We find repetitive tasks, improve how information moves and add AI-assisted steps. People keep oversight.
- [Cloud & Data](https://ai-alchemy.ca/services/cloud-data/): Make your information easier to reach, manage and use. We design cloud and data architecture for connected systems, reliable operations and room to grow.

## Industries

- [Industries overview](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/): The industries we work with, and the problems we fix in each.
- [Manufacturing, Wholesale & Logistics](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/manufacturing-wholesale-logistics/): Production, inventory, orders and operations. We connect sales, inventory, the shop floor and freight in one system.
- [Mortgage & Insurance](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/mortgage-insurance/): Information flow, documents and workflows, with review and accountability intact. We bring intake, documents, renewals and claims tracking into one place.
- [HVAC, Energy & Home Improvement](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/hvac-energy-home-improvement/): Field operations, customer records, scheduling and admin, connected. We link dispatch, field estimates and maintenance schedules.
- [Financial, Professional Services & Non-Profits](https://ai-alchemy.ca/industries/financial-professional-services-non-profits/): Internal systems, records, reporting and coordination. We keep each client's or donor's information in one place.
